title: Discipline Lead – Controls (BIM)
purpose: Accountable for quality, completeness, and consistency of Controls and Automation BIM content as it relates to show control, PLC hardware, control panels, field devices, and documentation delivery. Represents Controls authority for BIM documentation outcomes.
authority_statements: Approve or reject Controls discipline BIM states for use in technical and documentation milestones
Sign-off authority for Controls documentation readiness
Authority bounded by Controls scope and enterprise standards
Does not manage cross-discipline governance or alter enterprise standards
responsibilities: Ensure Controls BIM models support accurate, coordinated control system documentation
Align Controls resources with project milestones in TIDP
Evaluate coordination responses to preserve control panel clearances and cable pathway integrity
Formally approve Controls BIM models for documentation use based on externalized data
Review Controls data completeness using CSV/Excel extracts
accountabilities: Controls BIM content suitability for documentation outputs (panel schedules, I/O lists, layout sheets)
Controls participation in BIM coordination workflows
Controls BIM deliverables meeting milestone commitments
approvals: Controls discipline BIM model states approved for documentation use
Controls drawing packages, panel layouts, and I/O schedules
inputs: Control architecture schematics, network topology, and I/O requirements
BEP and coordination rules from Project BIM Manager / Coordinator
outputs: Controls drawing packages and device schedules
